newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady $104/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady $104/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady with last week's late trade, USDA said. Demand and seller interest improved as the day progressed.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - 64.00-65.00; dressed basis 104.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs - 103.50-104.00. Sales confirmed - 4,000 For the week - 14,600
